BiblicalUsage: Nebuchadnezzar learns his heart was made like the beasts, and he decrees there is no God who can deliver after this sort.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe like is the word that measures a king against a beast and a God against all gods, and the measure holds.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace
